name: TrustDemoCodeMappingBasis
title: How an imported dose got its national schedule code
description: The outcome of decision table TD.DT.02 (STD-SEM-001).

concept.definition: The issuer's product code has an equivalent schedule code in the national map.
The map had no entry; the clinician confirmed the equivalent, and the decision is added to the map.
No equivalent is known; the issuer's code is kept as it is and shown as unmapped.
The dose was not verified, so it was not imported and not mapped.
